description: User report 2026-10-22: an attached CHARACTER (Trajann) could be selected and shoot on its own, and its bodyguard could then be selected later in the same Shooting phase. 19.01: an Attached unit is ONE unit — it is selected to shoot once (10.02) and selects targets for all its weapons before any attack is resolved (04.02). Boyz F lead by two Warbosses: the shooter list offers one 'Boyz + Warboss + Warboss in Mega Armour' row and no Warboss rows; clicking a Warboss token selects the Boyz (whose weapon list carries the Warbosses' guns); the whole Attached unit shoots in one SHOOT; afterwards every component is marked shot and neither Warboss can be selected or SHOOT again.

steps.script:
var w = RulesEngine.get_unit_weapons("U_BOYZ_F", GameState.create_snapshot())
return w.has("U_WARBOSS_C:m1") and w.has("U_WARBOSS_IN_MEGA_ARMOUR_D:m1")
